notes.title: F1 25 is coming
notes.content:
Hello, Sim Racers! We're thrilled to announce that our latest update, arriving on May 30th, is packed with features to elevate your racing game:


 F1 25 Support: Instantly integrate and access crucial telemetry insights, including dynamic wheel camber. Enjoy improved data interpretation with new localized numeric codes.
 New SRT File Format: Experience faster telemetry loads and save disk space with a format that reduces file sizes by a third, paving the way for our upcoming cloud service.
 Enhanced User Experience:: Navigate effortlessly with the guided tour/walkthrough mode, benefit from multi-threading for quicker session updates, utilize new sortable columns, and much more!


And here's an exciting opportunity: Don’t miss out on the F1 25 DLC! Be sure to wishlist it to receive notifications as soon as it's available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692310/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_25/

Your feedback is invaluable to us — keep it coming, and happy racing! 🏁

notes.title: SRT v1.16 - Quality of Life
notes.content:
We're excited to present the latest updates to Sim Racing Telemetry, designed to enhance your experience and streamline your workflow.

In this release, you will find enhancements such as our revamped Recording Screen, a more intuitive Games List with smart ordering, and improved accessibility features, all aimed at making your interaction with SRT smoother and more efficient.

Read through the details below to discover what is included in this update. Thank you for your continued support and feedback, and we hope you enjoy the improved functionality!

Let's start

 The classic but essential: optimizations and bug fixes!
 Most views now feature a Help button that points directly to the user manual, helping you discover how to use SRT to its fullest.
 Our Games List has gotten smarter! With a smart ordering algorithm, your most recently used games will rise to the top, based on their last recorded session. No more tedious scrolling, it's all right          there at your fingertips!
 Looking for a specific lap to Compare? You can now filter the laps by Vehicle, Session Type, and User, making your selection process a breeze.
 When the app prompts you to configure a nickname before sharing a telemetry file, you can now do so without leaving the selected session. Keep your momentum going!


Recording Screen

Welcome to our all-new Recording Screen! While it won't show real-time telemetry just yet, it's a significant upgrade. You'll find useful information about your current recording, including a live chart of the number of telemetry samples received from the game - perfect for spotting any networking hiccups.
 We've added an application setting to enable or disable battery saver mode during recording. Available only on mobile and enabled by default, this feature lowers screen brightness while recording to help your device last longer.


Views Customization

 Introducing a new Telemetry Parameters selection dialog! We've simplified how you choose and arrange your telemetry parameters, with selected ones now pinned at the top for easy access and          reorganization.
 Customize the Lap Table view by pinning your favorite telemetry parameters at the top! This          way, you can transform that "wall of numbers" into a more manageable and useful display.
 Need to configure Statistics? Our new workflow lets you quickly select a parameter and customize its stats; you can even search for parameters by name and pin your chosen stats at the top for quick updates.
 When in Trial Mode, locked Telemetry Parameters are now conveniently grouped in a dedicated section, so you can easily spot the available ones.


Charts

 All charts now come with options to maximize, minimize, and restore them, so you can hide what you don't need and enlarge what you do!
 In the Session Charts view, we've enhanced the Lap Times and Race Positions charts! Laps with pit stops are now excluded from the lap times chart for a clearer picture of your performance.


Sessions List

 Filtering just got a boost! The Sessions List now supports filtering recordings by Session Type, helping you find exactly what you need.
 Our Sessions List highlights the best timings from the displayed sessions, making it easy to spot your top performances according to your chosen filters.


Accessibility

 Updated all colors to improve accessibility, especially for those with vision impairment, following the WCAG 2.1 AA standard.
 Even when using custom palettes, labels automatically select the most visible color to ensure          clarity, adhering to the WCAG 2.1 relative luminance directive.
 Formatting just got better! We now use spaces for digit grouping according to BIPM standards, and values are rounded for a consistent and polished look.


Please don't hesitate to share your feedback or reach out via email with any requests for new features and enhancements. Your voice helps shape our future!

notes.title: The User Manual is now available, and what's coming next
notes.content:
Hello racers!

A little announcement to let you know that we published the first version of the official User Manual of Sim Racing Telemetry. You can find it here: https://docs.simracingtelemetry.com/manual/start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/8dd105cb7b61ccc5168f6987c4064cd92a34219d.jpg

User Manual
We decided to keep it short and easy to read to help you quickly navigate through all the features provided by Sim Racing Telemetry.

Some sections are missing or incomplete due to changes planned for the next update.

Detailed recording instructions for supported games are still on the main website (https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/), under the Help menu.

Knowledge Base
Following the creation of the User Manual, we would also like to add a Knowledge Base section. Unlike the User Manual, which describes how the software works, the Knowledge Base will be a collection of small articles with tips on how to analyze telemetry data, how to create some ad-hoc configurations for specific games, helpful links and videos, etc.

Next update
The next update of Sim Racing Telemetry will mainly focus on Quality of Life features: bug fixes and a long list of minor changes that will improve the current UX of SRT. For this update, we decided to focus on improving existing features to make them easier to use, more accessible and useful.

The update will likely be released in September, right after the summer holidays.

Meanwhile, we're also working on major new features that we would like to release later this year. More on this in the near future :)

Happy racing folks!!

notes.title: SRT v1.15 - Support for F1 24 is now available
notes.content:
F1 24
Hello sim racers! Version 1.15 of Sim Racing Telemetry is now available, and it adds support for F1 24! We are really excited to make this update available early to everyone who pre-ordered the Champions Edition.

Get the DLC now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962200/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_24/

F1 24 is supported on all versions of SRT (desktop and mobile).

You can find setup instructions for F1 24 on our website or by pressing the Help button in the Recording screen.

New telemetry parameters
The new F1 24 protocol adds new interesting telemetry parameters, in particular:

 front/rear plank height, very useful for analyzing bottoming! They measure the height of the plank edges from the road surface.
 suspensions roll and chassis yaw, useful for analyzing car slips. Suspension roll is the angle relative to the rest position, while chassis yaw is the angle of the chassis relative to the direction of motion.
 exact speed-trap points, useful for comparing the top steed of different setups at a fixed reference position on the track.


We hope you enjoy this update. Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: v1.11 - Support for F1 22 and QoL improvements
notes.content:
Support for F1 22 is here!

We tried our best to release support for F1 22 as soon as possible! You can unlock the unlimited version in the dedicated DLC page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056900/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_22/

If you notice any issue, please report them using the e-mail button inside the app.

Press the Help button in the recording screen for configuration instructions.

To release the integration sooner, the new Racing Line feature introduced recently in v1.10 is currently not available for F1 22. But we're already working on it and it'll be available in a few weeks.

The updated version of SRT on mobile will roll-out following the approval process of the mobile digital stores. If you use SRT also on iOS or Android, this could require few extra days.

Quality of Life improvements

Following the process to improve the daily usage of SRT, we also introduced several improvements to the existing features of Sim Racing Telemetry:

 Improved the Racing Line view when in Comparison Mode

 The other compared vehicle is drawn with an independent pin.
 The current Delta Time is shown on screen.

 The pinch-to-zoom gesture on mobile has been rewritten, and now your fingers rule!
 ...and this is true also for the mouse cursor on desktop.
 Numerical values shown in the different tabs are always properly synched, not depending anymore on the zoom-level used by the tab.
 Improved rendering of Delta Time charts, in particular when zoomed-out. A much better smoothing is computed now, resulting in a more precise and less noisy curve on screen.
 Charts draw a highlighted horizontal line at Y=0 when needed. This helps detecting when a telemetry parameter value changes sign.
 The Position Chart in the Session View now plots only not-zero timings, resulting in a much better output.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/a7f5131ad10b4f2a6af7ba1eef4ae88b39b651c1.png

We hope you'll enjoy the work done for this release!

notes.title: Version 1.6.1
notes.content:
Hi!

v1.6.1
Thanks to your reports we fixed a possible issue on Windows: when the path or filename involved with an import/export operation contains not-latin characters, the operation can fail. Ensure to update to Version 1.6.1 and you will be able to import/export without restrictions. ハッピーレース。ːsteamhappyː

v1.6.0
In case you lost the announcement for the new version 1.6.0, here the new features:

 F1 2020 - native support for F1 2020 (by Codemasters). Instructions on how to configure SRT and F1 2020 can be found here: https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12020/.
 Sharing - you can now share your telemetries with other users and compare your laps with the ones from your friends. Used with the "comparison" feature, this is the best tool to improve your skills. Sharing and importing is simple: open a telemetry session and press the "Share" icon, select the "Share" option and send/save the file. When you receive a ".SRT" file, you can import it from the game screen pressing the "Import" icon.
 Exporting - a long-awaited feature is finally available: you can now export your telemetry data to CSV file, to analyze them with other programs (Excel, LibreOffice, etc.). Exporting data is simple: open a telemetry session and press the "Share" icon, select the "Export to CSV" option and send/save the file. Saving CSV files could require few minutes and could result in big files, so be patient when exporting them.


v1.6.0 is available on all the supported platforms, see our web site for the download links.

We hope you'll enjoy the new features. Happy racing!

notes.title: v1.5.0 is now available
notes.content:
Hi!

as anticipated few days ago, now version 1.5.0 is available on all platforms! Here the new features of this release:


 F1 2019 - this release adds native support for F1 2019 (by Codemasters). Instructions on how to configure SRT and F1 2019 are here: https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12019/ ;
 statistics module - this release adds the new "statistics" feature: you can now compute mathematical statistics for each supported telemetry parameter. This information is essential when you work on car setups. For example you can compute the maximum speed, the average tyre temperature, etc. Supported statistics are: min, max, arithmetic mean, standard deviation, median, median absolute deviation. The statistics can be configured for individual laps or for whole sessions, with output in tabular form and (for session statistics only) graphics charts. The lap statistics supports the "comparison" feature.
 under the hood - SRT now uses a "data flow" approach to automatically update the views when the underlying data change. This is an "hidden" feature and will help developing better features in the future. This is a big technical change and if you notice any bug, please report them at support@simracingtelemetry.com .
 Early Access - we decided to preserve the current "look" of SRT for the first release, so we have updated the Early Access description accordingly. Of course this is a very subjective opinion, and not everyone will agree, but we prefer to preserve the simplicity of the current interface and avoid to clutter it to mimic other more complex products ;) . But for the final release we'll add two very important features currently missing: sharing of telemetries and export of telemetries. With the sharing feature you'll have the option to send and receive copies of the telemetries to/from other users and friends; with the export feature you'll be able to export to CSV files all the data stored in a telemetry, allowing you to make your own analysis using external softwares like Excel, Matlab, etc.


As usual, the new version is available on all the supported platforms (PC, Mac, iOS, Android).
